            d[(r0,c0)] = n['color']

# need before tiles: recompute from saved 'before' boundary data
def tiles_from_saved(saved):
    d = {}
    for i,(col,px,b) in saved.items():

            r0 = min(p[0] for p in b); c0 = min(p[1] for p in b)
            d[(r0,c0)] = col
    return d
tb = tiles_from_saved(before)
ta = tiles(after_nodes)
print("changed tiles:")
for k in sorted(set(tb)|set(ta)):
    if tb.get(k) != ta.get(k):

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import copy
before = {n['id']:(n['color'], n['pixels'], tuple(sorted(n['boundary']))) for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']}
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':17,'col':20}])
after_nodes = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
# compare tile-level: build dict of (r0,c0,color) for 4px nodes
def tiles(nodes):
    d = {}
    for n in nodes:
        if n['pixels'] == 4:
            b = n['boundary']
            r0 = min(p[0] for p in b); c0 = min(p[1] for p in b)
            d[(r0,c0)] = n['color']
    return d
tb = tiles(before_nodes) if False else tiles([n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']])
# need before tiles: recompute from saved 'before' boundary data
def tiles_from_saved(saved):
    d = {}
    for i,(col,px,b) in saved.items():
        if px == 4:
            r0 = min(p[0] for p in b); c0 = min(p[1] for p in b)
            d[(r0,c0)] = col
    return d
tb = tiles_from_saved(before)
ta = tiles(after_nodes)
print("changed tiles:")
for k in sorted(set(tb)|set(ta)):
    if tb.get(k) != ta.get(k):
        print(k, tb.get(k), "->", ta.get(k))
print("board_changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'), "done:", last_action_result.get('done'))
